guarantees.claim: The initial block sets bits of share_perm_test according to RndCnstSharePerm indices and then asserts (&share_perm_test) is true, detecting any deviation from a full permutation.

assumptions.claim: RndCnstSharePerm array length is at least Width, ensuring for-loop index k < Width reads valid elements.
assumptions.risk: If Width > array size, loop reads out-of-bounds, causing X values and the assertion may miss an invalid permutation or produce a false failure.

assumptions.claim: share_perm_test has exactly Width bits, matching the loop and AND reduction.
assumptions.risk: Width mismatch leads to out-of-range writes, simulation errors, and the permutation check becoming meaningless.

uncertain_points.claim: The permutation check exists only in a simulation initial block; no synthesizable logic guards against a misconfigured RndCnstSharePerm in actual hardware.
uncertain_points.risk: A wrong permutation could silently bias or correlate PRNG outputs, breaking clearing integrity and potentially exposing secret material.
